notes.title: Play my Next Fest Demo Now!
notes.content:
The time has finally come! I'm very excited to announce that my newest demo for Randomice is live!
[previewyoutube=KTKMXx8qwuQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]What’s in the demo?[/h3]
[list][*] Wreak havoc in the house with a lighter and firecrackers.
[*] Traverse the rooms quickly with a magnetic grapple and a rocket.
[*] Each run is different and procedurally generated, taking place in hand-crafted rooms.
[*] French and English translations.[/list]

Head over to the store page to play the demo NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2835650/Randomice/

I would love to know what you think about my demo. Every bit of feedback that I get goes into making my game the best that it can be. You can post your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2835650/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], on [url=https://discord.gg/822hxJPy46]Discord[/url] or email me at feedback@videoludid.com

Make sure you follow me on [url=https://x.com/Videoludid]X/Twitter[/url] for more updates.
